title: One Loss Resolves Signed Rank-One Gradient Fibers: computational artifacts
description: Exact reconstruction software, synthetic public inputs and complete computational outcomes accompanying manuscript jsc-certified-2026.10.29.17. Preserves every earlier scientific snapshot and adds an indexed 15-page extended computational report with independently buildable LaTeX source. The report retains the expanded matched example, integer-lattice uniqueness and certificate-height refinements, complete per-input comparison and ablation tables, finite-grid outcomes and phase figure. All original measurements, empty and multiple lists, fallback cases, budget skips, 192 ablation runs, 180 completed lists, 12 censored timeouts and 72 propagation traces are retained. Saved-output replay does not remeasure timings. The main journal manuscript, essential journal supplement, private reviews and author declarations are not distributed in this software release.
